name: Kamarupa early core
historical_meaning: Best working origin; modern Kamrup district is not its ancient outline.

name: Karnasuvarna / Rajbadidanga
coordinate_status: Published excavated-mound coordinate; not exact camp
historical_meaning: Gauda capital and Bhaskara camp locality. Existing support CSV latitude 23.04 is wrong.

name: Gauda, historical region / polity
modern_orientation: Murshidabad core; extent changes with ruler and period
coordinate_status: Do not use a single point or permanent polygon
historical_meaning: Under Shashanka can denote much wider Bengal territory; later Pala usage broader still.

name: Gaur / Lakhnauti / Lakshmanavati
coordinate_status: Distinct later city; precise geometry not newly verified
historical_meaning: Do not substitute this later capital for Shashanka’s Karnasuvarna.

name: Pundranagara / Mahasthangarh
modern_orientation: Mahasthan near Bogura, Bangladesh, on the Karatoya
coordinate_status: Historical identification secure; new coordinate not verified
historical_meaning: City / nucleus of Pundravardhana; not the whole province.

name: Pundravardhana / Paundravardhana
modern_orientation: North Bengal core; later jurisdiction extends into eastern Bengal and Srihatta
coordinate_status: Time-dependent area; no fixed polygon supplied
historical_meaning: Ancient country and changing bhukti; cannot equal Ratnapitha.

name: Ratnapitha
historical_meaning: No early epigraphically dated sequence of possession of the entire sacred sector.

name: Karatoya
historical_meaning: Keep separate from modern Teesta; do not assume a modern combined river line is ancient.

name: Sankosh / Sonkosh / Swarnakosha
modern_orientation: Bhutan foothills to western Assam–north Bengal
historical_meaning: Eastern Ratnapitha limit in one later scheme.

name: Davaka / Dabaka
modern_orientation: Kopili–Jamuna country around Doboka, central Assam
historical_meaning: A distinct fourth-century frontier state; modern Hojai districts are display proxies only.

name: Barganga / Badaganga inscription
modern_orientation: Near Dakmaka / Tekegao in the Karbi Anglong–Nagaon region
coordinate_status: Site description checked; precise GPS not verified
historical_meaning: Local authority of Bhutivarman; no valid absolute date in revised reading.

name: Chandrapuri-visaya / Mayurasalmala
modern_orientation: Usually placed in greater Sylhet; older Purnea alternative
historical_meaning: The granted district, the Nidhanpur findspot and Karnasuvarna issue-place must have separate records.

name: Srihatta / Sylhet
historical_meaning: Kamarupa and Chandra evidence belongs to different periods; do not fill the intervening gap.

name: Hadapesvara / Haruppeswara
coordinate_status: Regional identification; exact ancient urban footprint uncertain
historical_meaning: Capital attested in later Salastambha and early Ratnapala records.

name: Sri Durjaya
modern_orientation: Commonly located near Guwahati; precise site unresolved
coordinate_status: Competing identification; no exact point endorsed
historical_meaning: The attached claim that Hadapyaka/Tezpur was renamed Durjaya should be corrected or explicitly labelled a hypothesis.

name: Uttara-kula
historical_meaning: Counter-evidence to reducing Pala Kamarupa to an exclusively south-bank kingdom.

name: Pandaribhumi / Mandi-visaya
historical_meaning: Do not locate by a grant beneficiary’s Sravasti origin.

name: Dijjina-visaya
modern_orientation: Diju / central Assam versus older Dinajpur identification
historical_meaning: False identifications can manufacture an otherwise unattested North Bengal annexation.

name: Lauhitya / Lohitya
historical_meaning: River reference in campaign and geographic accounts.

name: Odra
historical_meaning: Named in Harshadeva’s title; extent and duration of control not established.

name: Kalinga
historical_meaning: Named in Harshadeva’s title; extent and duration of control not established.

name: Kosala, probably Dakshina Kosala in this context
historical_meaning: Named in Harshadeva’s title; extent and duration of control not established.

name: Vanga
historical_meaning: Kalyanachandra’s realm in the Indrapala victory report; distinct from Gauda proper.

name: Nepal / Kathmandu valley
historical_meaning: Jayadeva–Rajyamati marriage does not establish Kamarupa conquest.

name: Nalanda
historical_meaning: Royal seal and communication evidence; annexation not established.

name: Tezpur
historical_meaning: Harjaravarman’s dated rock record is a local authority anchor.

name: Trisrota / Trishrota
modern_orientation: Often identified with Teesta in older reconstructions
coordinate_status: Historical identification must be tied to the particular grant
historical_meaning: Not a license to place every Vanamala grant in North Bengal.

name: Kamarupanagara
coordinate_status: Regional identification; exact ancient footprint unresolved
historical_meaning: Keep distinct from a fully verified Durjaya archaeological site.

name: Hamsakonci / Hamsakunchi
modern_orientation: Usually sought within the greater Kamrup region
historical_meaning: Issue-place of Vaidyadeva’s Kamauli charter; findspot Kamauli is near Varanasi.

name: Ganges / Ganga
coordinate_status: No exact endpoint of the Ratnapala advance established
historical_meaning: Reported arrival at a river is not ownership of its entire basin.
